This topic is part of the AQA GCSE Sociology specification.

The Sociology of Social Stratification appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet The Sociology of Social Stratification in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The AQA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with The Sociology of Social Stratification.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
